functionalArchitectureSummary.dryPath: Vented exhaust dryer with mechanical timer — inlet/outlet control thermostats, safety + high-limit, electric dual element or gas ignitor/valve path. Auto cycles hold timer until thermostats sense dry. No display error codes. Long-vent blower on some models.
functionalArchitectureSummary.washPath: Mechanical washer in same cabinet — extraction doc states washer is mechanical/timer platform; no electronic OEM test procedures ingested in v1 corpus.
functionalArchitectureSummary.integration: Unitized cabinet with shared power feed. Separate washer and dryer functional sections. Manual load transfer between sections — NOT single-drum wash→dry orchestration. Distinct from aio_laundry_combo.
functionalArchitectureSummary.aioRelevance: Explicitly NOT AIO — separate sections, no integrated_laundry_orchestration

procedureClassifications.provenance: High-limit, safety thermostat, heating element, 240 V at element — maps to vented_dryer heat_source + thermal_fuse/cutoff protection path.
Element 23.7–26 Ω; cycling thermostats biased near element/blower — same diagnostic role as vented_dryer temperature sensing and heat circuit protection.
Ignitor, flame sensor, gas valve coils, outlet thermostat — vented gas dry heat path; fuel-specific implementation overlay on heat_source.
Drive belt, idler, motor start/run windings — maps to vented_dryer drive_motor + door authorization gate.

Mechanical timer motor ~2.4 kΩ, timer contacts, 4500 Ω voltage-dropping resistor — realizes vented_dryer control_board/hmi_control/drying_control at platform layer; timer chart sequencing is implementation vocabulary.
procedureClassifications.frozenContractFit: vented_dryer drying_control via mechanical_timer platform overlay — not canonical node promotion

procedureClassifications.provenance: Restricted vent, long-vent blower motor — maps to vented_dryer exhaust_path + blower + lint restriction domains.
